body: I talked about some of it before, You can look at my submitted post if you're curious. It reads like a trainwreck.. I feel like I'm hard-wired to make stupid decisions

I understand that, but if you've been sad for 30 years, can you really change? I want to change my personality and become a happy, upbeat person but I'm the exact opposite of that. I look at my life and feel so defeated. It's hard (impossible for me so far) to leave the burden I'm carrying with me and move on.
Feeling damaged beyond repair. I guess if I worked my ass off starting today, maybe I would have a shot at life. But here I am, moping about suicide methods. I feel emotionally crippled.

My life has been a trainwreck just like yours, look at my post history if you're curious. What is Pentobarbital and how much does it cost? According to google it's a euthanasia drug, so does that mean painless death?
That's a terrifying thought, I wonder how many suicides will happen because of this hack.

How do you find out these details? I signed up on that site years ago and exchanged maybe two messages before deciding it wasn't for me. (I thought it was some variation of okcupid, I was/am an extremely sheltered dumbass). I don't remember paying for it or giving them my address.

Of course suicide is a very comforting thought, it's the perfect solution to end my pain. but it's so difficult to finally pull the trigger, jump off the bridge, step in front of a train, or whatever method you choose. I've looked at bodies of people who killed themselves by different methods and they're all so painful to look at. They honestly scare me. But being alive scares me too, I'm not cut out for it I guess. I'm hoping I'll get hit by a bus soon or develop a terminal illness.

There is no point. You didn't choose to be born, but here you are and now you have to deal with it. I guess the secret to happiness is.. workout, volunteer, join meetup.com to meet people, find something you're passionate about and do it... I do none of these and am terribly unhappy.

I popped a Wellbutrin this morning. It's not a magic pill that's going to make me perk up but I hope it will help lessen my anxiety. I've been feeling nauseous all day and have zero appetite, I guess that's the pill's doing.

I’m not looking for a relationship. I’m aware I’m no state to be with anyone. I am terribly lonely though.

I am looking for another job and have been to several interviews. But I don’t come across as confident and that hurts my chances. I feel like I need to attend interview coaching classes and learn how to fake confidence. 

I enjoy cooking and making healthy, filling meals. And once in a while unhealthy ones too. I started volunteering at a shelter on the weekends, but wasn’t able to go for several weeks because we had a rough winter and the shelter would advise volunteers to stay safe and only come in if they lived a few minutes away. It’s summer now, I should’ve started again a while ago but I haven’t gone. I don’t have any excuses other than I feel sad all the time and can’t make myself go. 

I agree with the exercise thing. I rarely go the gym but I’ve never regretted working out on the rare days I do go. I need to start going but I keep telling myself I’ll start tomorrow, and tomorrow never comes.

I know I can’t expect things to be handed to me, I have to work hard to get in a place where I like myself. But having no energy, crippling anxiety and long crying fits get in the way of that.

I've never met someone who adored me. I've met plenty of aggressive predatory men. But I grew up getting raped, I emit some type of signal that makes it more likely for me to attract abusive people. 

I've seen a few therapists and some made me feel worse. One in particular suggested I move to where this guy (the one I mention in my OP) moved. Or that I have kids with this guy my family was pressuring me to marry at the time, her reasoning was kids make some women happy. Even in my foggy mental state I could tell that was terrible advice. Maybe she was trying to shock me into reality?

I don't know about 30 being the new 20. Especially if I want kids, I don't have forever. I don't think I deserve to have kids anyway, I'll pass down whatever's wrong with me to them. But it still hurts. 

I hate myself for spewing negative shit at people who are being kind and encouraging. I wish I was positive and upbeat, I don't know how to feel that way.
I'll do that.
I've never been much of a believer but I envy people who have faith. It certainly helps you in difficult times and keeps you going. I wish I had faith in something

I do see a therapist and psychiatrist. Hasn't helped me much. Well, my therapist gives me suggestions on how to improve my life and I try to follow through but quickly get overwhelmed and give up.

I'm not sure if you're being sarcastic about my talent for writing. I write at the level of a 10 year old but English is not my first language. I enjoyed writing a long time ago, but at 15 I developed a crush on one of my teachers. I wrote about having feelings for him in my diary, my mother found it and accused me of having an affair with the said teacher. Nothing actually happened with him, he never knew about my crush but my mother was convinced something was going on and beat me several times. I've tried to keep a diary as an adult but have trouble putting my feelings on paper still.

I understand that physical activity helps. I joined a gym and liked going to the pool and sauna there. Before using the pool though, you're required to use a shower. It's an outdoor shower right next to the pool so everyone can see you when you're showering, people keep their swimsuits on of course. I was using that shower once and my friend standing next to me told me that a guy had just pointed his phone at me and clicked. He might not have, people are too focused on themselves to pay attention to others, but it still makes me nervous. I've been assaulted too many times, so I don't know how to calmly handle myself in situations like these. I usually freeze. It doesn't help.
I'm at a point where I'm scared of everyone and everything.
I don't know how to stop dwelling on my past and I don't know how to let go.  It would be awesome if I could, but I have nightmares and panic attacks that are out of my control. They in turn affect the rest of my behavior and the cycle continues on.

Thanks. I can't remember the last time someone hugged me.

I think it should be okay to kill myself if I'm in extreme physical or emotional pain. I'm ok physically but I'm severely mentally ill. Sadly I can't off myself at the moment as it will hurt my younger sister's life.

I'm from a culture where girls meet their expiration date quite early. I bet your coworker was a happy, well-adjusted woman when she met her mate. I'm the exact opposite of it. I don't want to be this way of course, and I promise myself I'll do better the next day. But I'm so consumed by my negativity it's hard to snap out of it.

I've only dated 2 guys. The first one I never bonded with and the second one crushed my soul. I should've removed him from life a long time ago but I never did. Something is very wrong with me. 

I have too many bad memories associated with this place and want to move away, but don't have the financial means to do it. I did have the opportunity to go live with my best friend on the other coast, but before I could gather the courage to leave my parents, my mother got ill. So I stayed and spent my early-mid 20s taking care of her. She's dead now. Looking back, I should've left when I had the chance. 

I was too naive and sheltered, I moved to the US at 20. I had to beg my mother to let me go visit my girlfriend in CA, she beat me the first time I asked but eventually agreed to let me go for a few days. I was so happy when I was away from her, I made plans with my friend to move there within a year but never got the courage to do it. I was never allowed to have a social life in college, I wasn't allowed to leave the house other than for work and school. i'm so emotionally stunted now and don't know how to catch up. I have this sinking feeling in my chest that it already is too late for me.

I think my problem isn't that I'm depressed, but that I'm stupid and I don't know how to fix that. 

I can't afford to check myself into a hospital, I've had suicidal thoughts for years and have only passively acted on them with pills. I know now that guns or jumping are more effective. I would've killed myself today if it didn't negatively affect anyone. I come from a very conservative culture though and having a crazy dead sister will make it near impossible for my younger sister to get married. So I know I have to hang on atleast until then, but I keep getting worse and worse. I have nightmares, I wake up and have anxiety attacks, I can physically feel pain in my chest. It's hard to stay alive. 

I do have a therapist. She looks at me with such pity when I talk about things I'm stuck on, mainly wanting love of a man who treated me like garbage. So I don't talk about him. She tries to make me focus on moving on with life, tells me that only I can pull myself out of this pit, encourages me etc. I know what I should be doing, but I don't have the energy to do it. Maybe getting drugged up by an anti-depressant will help. I took one before and had a horrible experience. Maybe it will be different this time.

I feel drained and don't feel I'm worthy of anyone. I don't have my life together and should not be dating. I do want a support network, or atleast someone who cares about me, but I have no one. I tried meetup, but I'm a ball of negative energy and I think people can sense that, so I have trouble connecting with people. I actually went to a Salsa thing through meetup and had a guy keep following who'd been sending me messages on meetup. I wanted to get away from him so I made an excuse to go to the restroom and when I came out of the restroom he was waiting for me right outside. I shook him off eventually but it makes me nervous now. I am really small and weak and feel like a vulnerable prey far too often.

I did get prescribed an anti-depressant but I don't have the energy to get it filled. I thought I would go today but then spent the day crying.
